record_title: Eliminating the dimension-24 Type-II exception in the Knutson classification
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The dimension-at-most-31 conclusion inherits the hypotheses and non-exceptional case analysis of Martin Duro's Corollary 2.32.
No claim is made for semisimple Hopf algebras of dimension greater than 31.

Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the stabilizer-divisibility theorem is classical, and the claimed contribution is the application eliminating the published Type-II exception. An unindexed correction or equivalent observation may exist.
